description:
Search Booking.com properties for a destination or property name (scores out of 10);
        returns the hotel ids ('fr-ibis-budget-paris-porte-de-bercy') the other Booking tools
        take.

        Cost: 1 credit per call (also when nothing matches).

        Args:
            query: Destination or property name, e.g. 'Paris'.
            limit: Results to return, 1-10 (default 10).
            cursor: `next_cursor` from a previous call for more results (1 credit).
name: booking_search_hotels
title: Search Booking.com properties
